Zadig 2.9 - USB driver installation made easy
https://zadig.akeo.ie/

zadig.exe is the unmodified official binary, bundled into EduPrinterSystem.exe
and opened from its settings window to install the libusbK driver for the
printer.

Downloaded from:
  https://github.com/pbatard/libwdi/releases/download/v1.5.1/zadig-2.9.exe
